item.title: Notion
item.description:
What is Notion?

A workspace for organizing notes, projects, documents, and team knowledge.

Key features

  • Organize notes and documents

  • Manage projects and tasks

  • Keep team knowledge in one workspace

Who is it for?

People who want notes, projects, and documentation in one workspace.

Where to learn more

Visit the official website to check the current features, plans, and terms before deciding whether the tool suits your needs.

item.title: Obsidian
item.description:
What is Obsidian?

A note-taking application that helps you organize connected ideas and personal knowledge.

Key features

  • Create linked notes

  • Build a personal knowledge base

  • Organize information in a local vault

Who is it for?

People who want to connect research, notes, and ideas.

Where to learn more

Visit the official website to check the current features, plans, and terms before deciding whether the tool suits your needs.

item.title: Trello
item.description:
What is Trello?

A visual project management tool built around boards, lists, and cards.

Key features

  • Visual task boards

  • Track work through lists and cards

  • Organize personal or team projects

Who is it for?

Individuals and teams who prefer a visual overview of tasks.

Where to learn more

Visit the official website to check the current features, plans, and terms before deciding whether the tool suits your needs.
